parameters.content: The AI plays the event producers. Code decides each slot (supplier order, sponsor or exhibitor order, amendment, credit note, resend); the model writes the content; code checks every value, assigns keys and versions, and renders the PDF. In real life these documents come from suppliers, sponsors, and exhibitors.
A rejected event (out of range, bad category, unknown key) is logged in the execution and skipped; the day goes on.
